left.raw_text: Older than the age of legal consent (i.e. 18 years old)
Sonographic diagnosis of ovarian endometrioma with diameter at least 4cm on 2 separate scans at least 6 weeks apart
contraindication to use of progesterone or combined oral contraceptive pills
attempting to conceive either at the time of study entry or for at least 2 years after surgery

right.raw_text: Willing and able to participate after the study has been explained
